scene: The gardener's belt jingling with transit tokens reveals three waiting exits.
picture: A flat side view along the edge of the rink. On the far left, a floral gondola bobs at an open railing. The player in lilac headscarf and mustard coat stands left. At centre, a river barge sits moored along a low canal edge. On the far right, a brightly lit glass-roofed trolley waits at a terminal.
shown: a swinging floral garden gondola docked at an iron gate on the left
a wooden river barge moored at a water slip at centre
a brass trolley with a glass curved roof waiting on tracks on the far right
